item.title: Florida executes man convicted of killing woman during 1989 home invasion
item.description: STARKE, Fla. (AP) — A man convicted of fatally stabbing a woman during a home invasion decades ago was executed Tuesday evening in Florida. item.title: How to watch one of the year's best meteor showers, the Geminids
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — It's time for one of the strongest meteor showers of the year. The Geminids peak this weekend and are visible through mid-December, according to the American Meteor Society.
